name: The Pomodoro Technique
instructions: Work in focused 25-minute intervals ("pomodoros"), followed by a 5-minute break -- a simple structure that makes starting easier.
Take a longer 15-20 minute break after every four pomodoros to actually recover, not just switch tasks.
Use the timer as a commitment device: for 25 minutes, only the one task exists.
Watch today's short video explaining the technique before your first round.
